tweetText: AdventHealth is implementing ChatGPT for Healthcare to improve workflows and lessen administrative tasks. This change aims to give healthcare providers more time to focus on patient care. via OpenAI News

Spotify teams up with Universal Music to let Premium users create AI covers and remixes, sharing revenue with artists. This could change how fans engage with music and support their favorite creators. via TechCrunch AI
Google is changing its search experience, and many users may not like the new AI overview feature. It's important to explore alternatives as search engines evolve. via TechCrunch AI

Trump has postponed signing an executive order for government security reviews of AI models, claiming the wording could pose issues. This delay raises concerns about AI safety and regulation amid growing technological threats. via TechCrunch AI

Spotify is rolling out AI features that allow users to create daily or weekly podcast briefs based on their prompts. This makes it easier for listeners to get quick updates and highlights from their favorite shows. via TechCrunch AI

Spotify has launched a new audiobook creation tool powered by ElevenLabs, allowing authors to generate audiobooks without exclusive contracts. This gives creators the freedom to publish their works wherever they choose. via TechCrunch AI

The Path, created by Tony Robbins and Calm veterans, claims its AI therapy model scored 95 on a mental health safety benchmark, far exceeding consumer bots' top score of 65. This could lead to safer AI-driven mental health support. via TechCrunch AI

Hark just raised $700M for its secretive AI interface, planning to launch multimodal models this summer. This could reshape how we interact with various products and services through a personal AI platform. via TechCrunch AI

Google unveiled a new AI agent ecosystem at its I/O conference, aiming to enhance web usage for consumers. However, the concept left many confused, raising questions about its adoption. via TechCrunch AI

Aluminum prices have surged 20%, prompting recycling startups to leverage AI for better mineral recovery. This could significantly boost the supply of critical metals and reshape the recycling industry. via TechCrunch AI
